title: The empty language has bounded tree size
statement: Let $T$ be a function from the natural numbers to the natural numbers such that $1\le T(n)$ for every $n$. The empty language has a Boolean tree circuit for each input length $n$, of size at most $T(n)$, whose acceptance condition agrees with membership in the empty language on every Boolean string.
